justifications.durability: The run converts an uncommitted reconciliation into a committed, executable check: tests/test_outboard_census_receipt_consistency.py asserts the receipt's own verdict derivation and reconciles the committed receipt with the numbers the fragment publishes, and it is mutation-sensitive (shown above). This directly closes the durability gap the parent review recorded ('nothing in the repository would redden if _recommendation regressed or if the receipt and the fragment desynchronize again'). Residual: the invariance of the chord total and the per-cell bookings across the routing change is pinned as values but not asserted as a movement, so a future reroute that moved them silently would still pass as long as it landed on the same numbers.
justifications.evidence: Every headline number is independently reproducible from the committed artefacts. This review measured terminal_booked_currents at head 123111a0e in a clean archive with JAX_PLATFORMS=cpu: exact 15491539.124767259 A (equals the pin exactly, relative 0.0), chord 15875439.764504183 A (relative 1.17e-16 vs the unchanged pin), and the five outboard cells nonzero and matching MEASURED_CELL_CURRENT_A to full precision. The base arm is a real reproduction, not a restated claim: gate-base-22faa10eb.log shows 1 failed 2 passed EXIT=1 with test_booked_totals_reproduce_the_committed_state naming exact 15,491,539.124767 outside 1e-6 of the stale 14,013,835.43717596 pin. Source is byte-identical between base and head (git diff base..head touches only two tests, one evidence fragment and one figure JSON), so the chord total and the five per-cell bookings are unchanged because nothing that books them moved -- verified by the pin diff (chord and MEASURED_CELL_CURRENT_A untouched, only BOOKED_TOTALS_A exact and a signature reformat changed). The consistency test imports the benchmark's own _recommendation (line 21) and fails under the declared mutation: forcing _recommendation to return 're-pin' gives 6 failed, 3 passed, EXIT=1 -- matching the run's negative-control.log exactly. Demerit only for the fence's stated evidence number differing in the 6th decimal from the merged evidence, which is immaterial to the decision.
justifications.fit: New symbols and files are mechanism-named (test_outboard_census_receipt_consistency.py, _receipt, _fragment_text, _revision, _grouped, _recommendation) and carry no plan, sprint or ticket label. The receipt artefact was committed under the run's own figure directory (docs/figures/forward-solve-api/fsapi-outboard-census-repin/paired-final-head.json) so the test reads data rather than retyped constants -- the right call.
